issues.description: The UML in problem_statement.md declares getTotalNumberOfStudents(): String, but the intended/implemented API in the solution uses an int return type for getTotalNumberOfStudents(). The problem text even tells students to check the UML for the expected return type, which will mislead them into implementing a String return type instead of an int and cause confusion or test failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type for getTotalNumberOfStudents consistent across artifacts. Update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (and any explanatory text that points students to the UML), or alternatively change the implementation and tests to return String if that was intentional. Prefer updating the UML to int to match the numerical nature of the value and the solution implementation.
